faculties.description: Since its inception in 2012, ITU has been redefining modern education and the perception of research-oriented universities in Pakistan. The Faculty of Science has developed and provided solutions to several local problems and remains committed to not only generating research-based solutions, but also to developing solutions that can be scaled up and can constructively impact the mores of modern industry and education.

The Faculty of Engineering at Information Technology University, Lahore was established in 2013 with the aim of providing state of the art engineering education and research facilities to meet the next generation challenges. Comprising the Department of Electrical Engineering (EE) and the Department of Computer Engineering (CE), we have world-class faculty who have studied and worked in institutions of international repute.
departments: Department of Computer and Software Engineering

faculties.description: The Faculty of Business and Management Science offers 3 programs, EMBA (formerly known as EMBITE), BS Management and Technology and MS Management and Technology. Both these programs are designed to leverage ITU’s established excellence in technology and impact the practice of management, while giving the students an integrated command over tech innovation.

ITU has been pushing the frontiers of inter-disciplinary research since its inception in 2012. This objective resulted in the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences being established in 2015. Consequently, new pathways have been opened to increasingly relevant problems which allows scholars to focus on interdisciplinary realms which rarely cross paths otherwise.
departments: Department of Governance and Global studies

faculties.description: The Faculty of Arabic and Islamic Studies started functioning as an Institute of Arabic and Islamic Studies comprising departments of Arabic and Islamic Studies. The Institute of Arabic and Islamic Studies was upgraded as a full-fledged faculty in 1998.
departments: DEAN SECRETARIAT OF ARABIC & ISLAMIC STUDIES

faculties.description: The Faculty of Education established in 1984 is an outgrowth of the Institute of Education, which came into existence in 1976 right after the establishment of the university. It is one of the largest faculties of the university with 47% enrolment of the university and contributor of 53% to the total annual university exchequer. At present 30 programmes and 135 courses in its eight department/Institutes are being run by the faculty.
departments: EDUCATIONAL PLANNING, POLICY STUDIES AND LEADERSHIP (EPPSL)

faculties.description: The Faculty of Sciences at AIOU was first established in 1982 only with five departments and limited number of undergraduate and basic functional courses. Over last three to four years, five new departments and a range of higher degree programmes have been added to the portfolio of Faculty of Sciences. Most of the departments, in the Faculty, are now engaged in the offering highly technical, scientific and professional courses.

faculties.faculty_name: Faculty of Social Sciences and Humanities
faculties.description: First established in 1981 with five departments, the Faculty of Social Sciences and Humanities has over the Years, flourished to become by far the largest Faculty of the University. It, today consists of fifteen departments offering programmes at different levels in various areas like Business Administration, Economics, Mass Communication, Sociology, Women Studies, Urdu, Library & Information Sciences, History, Pakistan Studies, MBA in collaboration with Common Wealth countries, French (Online), and Teaching of English as a Foreign Language (TEFL). Similarly, in tune with the government's policy of promoting and strengthening a culture of higher education and research in the country, the Faculty of Social Sciences and Humanities has shown dynamism over the past five years.
